concerns.text: FR-005 (Permutation tests & FDR) is unimplemented. T025b (Permutation Test Loop) is marked incomplete, and T025c (FDR Correction) depends on it. No task exists to execute the 10,000 shuffles required by FR-005, leaving the core statistical validation missing.

FR-006 (Riemannian trajectory analysis) and FR-007 (Bootstrapped CIs) are unimplemented. Tasks T030, T031a, T031b, T031c, T033a, and T033b are all marked incomplete/rejected. The entire spatial route shift and uncertainty quantification capability is missing.

FR-001 (Data Download) and SC-005 (Runtime) are blocked. T002a (Project Structure) is rejected, and T005b/T005c1 (Data Download) are incomplete. Without raw data, downstream tasks (T015b, T023a) cannot execute, violating the plan's data acquisition phase.

FR-002 (Filtering/Aggregation) and FR-003 (Phenology Metrics) are unimplemented. T015b (Preprocessing Pipeline) is incomplete, preventing the generation of `preprocessed_data.parquet` required by T023a (GAMM) and T030 (Centroids).

FR-004 (GAMM Fitting) is unimplemented. T023a (Fit GAMM) is rejected/incomplete. Without model fits, T025b (Permutation), T025c (FDR), and T033a (CI) have no input data, blocking the core statistical analysis.

Plan governance (Data Source Substitution) is unimplemented. T050a/T050b (Deviation Whitelist) are rejected, and T005c3 (Deviation JSON) is incomplete. The plan explicitly requires a whitelisted deviation mechanism for NOAA→Daymet substitution, which is missing.

SC-001 to SC-005 (Success Criteria) are unmeasured. T043 (Calculate and Report All Success Criteria) is incomplete. Dependencies T043b (Power), T043c1 (Data Coverage), T043c2 (Convergence), and T043d (CI Width) are all incomplete, leaving no validation of project goals.

Plan optimization goals are unimplemented. T039a1/T039a2 (Runtime Optimization) are incomplete. The plan mandates CPU-tractable methods and streaming; without these tasks, the 6-hour runtime constraint (SC-005) is at risk.
